decisions.reason: The name, role summary, and all listed denials are supported by the source.
The role, employer, dates, Dispatch Loom work, and coworker training are supported in the context of this employment.

The source says operators preferred a visible warning and supervisors wanted understandable exceptions; it does not establish that operators used those features. The request to distinguish operational use from external sale does not itself establish that the tool was not sold externally.
The source supports Roster Note as a separate SQL handover checklist Ada personally built at Harbor Tools, and states no user count or outcome was recorded.
The 5-to-2-hour weekly reconciliation result over six runs, its 3-hour arithmetic reduction, team attribution, Ada’s contribution, and the distinction from delivery speed are supported.
The source supports training 12 dispatch coworkers in two workshops, writing the plain-language handbook, and its five worked examples.
The source says Ada personally wrote the Python parser for Dispatch Loom.
The source supports SQL checks for Dispatch Loom and a separate SQL handover checklist for Roster Note.
The source says PostgreSQL was used for the production database in the Dispatch Loom context.
The source says Ada used Git for version control in the Dispatch Loom context.
The source supports personally training dispatch coworkers and writing a handbook describing where to look before raising an exception.
The source explicitly lists Python, SQL, and PostgreSQL in the Data tools skill category.
